findings.note: Same premise as land-played-v2: no land played this turn.
Scout's ability taps Scout and becomes S1; after two implied passes it resolves and asks A for an optional land card from hand.
A puts the first Forest onto the battlefield; S1 ceases to exist; A receives priority. Putting the land does not count as the turn's land play.
With its one land play still unused, A legally plays the second Forest as a special action, keeping priority with an empty stack (Scout ruling 2018-04-27).
